# SI Console

> Project repo for SI Console, a Raspberry Pi 5 physical console for supervising AI agents (Hack Club Fallen). The R3 drawings are superseded; Rev R5 (open-frame) CAD is in `cad/` and `blueprints/R5/`; the boxed R4.2 is in `research/R4.2-boxed/`.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): human front page, team, status, open decisions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents, source of truth, what not to edit
- [INDEX.json](INDEX.json): machine-readable manifest with status and owner
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): dated revision log

## Docs
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): authoritative merged v1 agent runtime spec (Jayden + Christopher) plus implementation gaps
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAMS.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAMS.md): 10 Mermaid diagrams of the whole architecture, with per-part status legends
- [docs/MODEL_TIERS.md](docs/MODEL_TIERS.md): ACCEPTED 2026-11-25 final model roster, tier chains, Jev judge, final culls, per-orchestrator pinning, T2 worker allowlists, booth arena design and cost
- [docs/decisions.md](docs/decisions.md): case, mini screen, model router (accepted 2026-11-25, see MODEL_TIERS.md) and the 5 open R3 review items
- [docs/SI_Console_Overview.md](docs/SI_Console_Overview.md): 2 page overview, connection diagram, parts table, 3 decisions
- [docs/SI_Console_Detailed.md](docs/SI_Console_Detailed.md): full 13 section compiled document
- [docs/ONSHAPE_IMPORT.md](docs/ONSHAPE_IMPORT.md): how to import the STEP files into Onshape or Fusion 360
- [docs/GPIO_PIN_MAP.md](docs/GPIO_PIN_MAP.md): the only GPIO map: pins, grounds, ULN2003 wiring and resistor math

## Bill of materials
- [bom/BOM.csv](bom/BOM.csv): the only current BOM, Rev R5, 851.13 CAD fundable before tax
- [bom/BOM_NOTES.md](bom/BOM_NOTES.md): totals and the cuts applied

## CAD, Rev R5 (open frame, parametric, current)
- [cad/README.md](cad/README.md): the design, how to run, how to change a dimension, list of ASSUMED dimensions to measure
- [cad/params.py](cad/params.py): every dimension and switch, each tagged VERIFIED, ASSUMED or DESIGN
- [cad/build.py](cad/build.py): regenerates STEP, DXF, drawings, renders and checks
- [cad/output/CHECKS.md](cad/output/CHECKS.md): check results
- [cad/output/ASSUMED.md](cad/output/ASSUMED.md): measure with calipers before cutting
- [blueprints/R5/](blueprints/R5/): finals. `si_console_assembly_R5.step`, `step/`, `dxf/` (laser, 2 sheets), `drawings/` (SVG, PDF), `renders/`
- [blueprints/R5/wiring_diagram_R5.svg](blueprints/R5/wiring_diagram_R5.svg): current wiring diagram ([PNG](blueprints/R5/wiring_diagram_R5.png))
- [docs/images/](docs/images/): R5 renders
- [research/R4.2-boxed/](research/R4.2-boxed/): the boxed case alternative (Rev R4.2) with its outputs and source

- [blueprints/3d/README.md](blueprints/3d/README.md): list of per-part STEP and STL files

## Code
- [code/README.md](code/README.md): what is built, what is planned, and the test command
- [code/si_console/coordinator.py](code/si_console/coordinator.py): agent loop
- [code/si_console/bridge.py](code/si_console/bridge.py): vault watcher, buttons, LEDs
- [code/si_console/gpio_map.py](code/si_console/gpio_map.py): GPIO constants (code side)
- [code/tests/](code/tests/): 163 mocked tests, no Pi needed
